requirements.text: Currently pursuing an Undergraduate/Graduate in Software Development, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Computer Graphics, or a related technical discipline.
Able to commit to working for 12 weeks during the Summer of 2027.
Strong knowledge of data structures and algorithms, proficient in at least one coding language, including but not limited to C++, Python, Javascript.
Curiosity towards graphics, real-time rendering, and mobile performance, and outstanding ability to analyze and solve problems.
Good grasp of software engineering and how to build a system in a scalable and extensive manner.
Passion about performance and solving challenging problems on real devices.
Understanding of real-time rendering and graphics APIs such as OpenGL ES, Metal, or Vulkan.
Experience in GPU and rendering performance analysis tools such as RenderDoc, Xcode GPU Debugger, Perfetto, or Snapdragon Profiler.
Interest in AI Agent development, and in exploring how LLM-powered tools can improve engineering workflows.
